The intercept stays at 1; the second point moves with m." states the conclusion the learner asked to explore. p37: the A39 mapping is disputed.

rows.scenario_summary: Exact: "原屏幕实时使用本产品笔标注；滚动、缩放、题面变化及停止共享 | 用户仍在可见且可操作的原页面／应用，Pencil／所支持输入的笔迹实际进入 AI 收到的叠加画面；原笔迹与来源锚点不漂移，不误截正常导航或触发讲解，停止共享后不再冒充实时。分别验证网页层、Windows 桌面层和 iPad/iPhone 原生 App 层，逐平台／页面报告支持、未验证或不支持；独立画布／冻结截图不算此项通过。"
paths_or_platforms: web live overlay on supported pages (iPad Safari; desktop Safari separately), per page type incl. iframe/fullscreen/video
Windows original-desktop annotation layer (P3, currently unverified)
iPad/iPhone native-app interactive layer over third-party apps (Canvas, Notability), per app/OS: unverified or evidenced unsupported
fallbacks (frozen/own canvas/side-by-side) are A45 and NEVER count here

Windows (P3): on a real Windows device, annotate over a native window; test input passthrough, window switching, DPI scaling and overlay capture. iPad/iPhone native: attempt over Canvas/Notability using public APIs only; record per-app/OS status with evidence.

rows.scenario_summary: Exact: "留在原课程上课并用本产品笔记屏幕笔记 → 保存 → AI 必要补充 → Notability 导入 | 联动 A26–A28/A44：实际原屏幕书写、可编辑原笔迹及当时来源／画面／视频位置保留，AI 图／公式／短说明独立可删；按官方支持分享／导入记录实际目标状态。分享面板出现不等于已导入，不承诺无公共接口的静默写入，PDF/PNG 不称 Notability 原生可编辑笔划；本 App 原稿仍可编辑。失败或备选不伪称原位成功，导出成功也不能补齐未通过的 A44。"
paths_or_platforms: original-screen writing on a supported path (web overlay / iPad native / Windows P3)
app-held editable original plus source/frame/video position

Request an AI addition, then hide or delete it. Export to Notability via the share sheet, open Notability, complete the import, inspect the imported note (not native strokes), and confirm the app original is still editable.

rows.scenario_summary: Exact: "G7 做题过程、原屏幕笔记与克制提示 | 按入口测网页选择／输入／canvas、外部视觉、自有操作日志和同题关联；分网页、Windows、iPad/iPhone 验证本产品原屏幕实时标注及 AI 叠加可见；检查完整性、诊断、全渠道提示、语言及到 Notability 流程 | 不要求所有外部 App 通过；各路径标明支持／未验证／不支持。P1 可完成支持路径单题闭环，冻结／画布／并排仅作明确备选，不能计为 R59/A44 通过；A46 还需原稿／来源／AI层和真实导入证据"
rows.fixture_gap: A26-A28 and A41-A46 have zero fixtures. The fixtures are pinned to spec 57aee9c, not the e432937 baseline. Single synthetic device; no 'mixed' coverage path. The content of reference step 'b' is missing in p02 and p12. Hygiene: 15 cases request the nonexistent step 'b'; coverage.path contradicts step kinds in p07 and p18.
rows.expected_evidence: A capability matrix per entry/platform/app/OS marked supported/unverified/unsupported, with device/OS/SDK versions, the real operations, evidence and any fallback enabled. Source implementation, compilation, automated checks and real verification are reported separately.
rows.deterministic_rule_checks: QA reproduced the P0-10 probe in scratch (/tmp/qa-p0-13/work/matrix/rule-run): 37/37 structural agreement, rows identical to the author's report, rule sha256 bd5bcb00..., fixture hashes match the manifest, Python 3.14.4. Proposed rule additions: mastery-type/help consistency and a closed label enum; requested_steps must exist; coverage.path consistent with step kinds; absolute_first forbidden on visual evidence or without a cited deviation; language check for every level; local premises allowed in check scope; idempotent replay dedup; presentation-time version binding.
rows.independent_math_semantic_review: QA (Opus; the fixtures were authored by the Astra learning role) reviewed 37/37: 25/25 math checks correct (scratch math_check.py). Disagreements recorded next to the author labels, without relabeling: p07 missing violation; p29 plausible leak; p34 uncertain leak; p37 confirmed semantic leak (structure passes); p32/p37/p27 mapping weak; p04 parent semantics; p06 ambiguity not in coverage; p30 checked line absent; p12/p28 coverage_status counted as reference steps. Among structurally allowed candidates: 1 confirmed and 1 plausible premature disclosure. 0/31 non-empty candidate texts fabricate steps; 1 fabricated metadata reference (p07 'missing-step') was caught by the rule. 0 false independent-mastery labels among accepted candidates (p35 was caught). This is one model's perspective, not a certificate; the spec also requires a human reviewer and a real user trial.
rows.real_device_or_user_steps: The union of the device steps in A26-A28, A41, A44, A45 and A46, plus consented user trials for A32-A40 on at least one supported iPad path.
rows.stage: P0 (synthetic cases + per-platform investigation) -> P1 (single-problem loop on one supported iPad path) -> P2 (practice/mastery, Notability chain) -> P3 (cross-device, Windows desktop layer)
rows.pass_criteria_and_denominator: Per path: the fixed set has 0 premature disclosures, 0 fabricated steps and 0 false independent-mastery labels, each with an explicit denominator. Not every external app must pass. A fallback never counts for R59/A44. A46 needs import evidence. Current state: synthetic fixture review 37/37, product executions 0, so G7 is untested and not passed.
rows.blocking_dependencies: P0-08 contract; P0-09; P0-11; P0-12; device path (Mac/Xcode/iPad/Windows); runnable candidates; human reviewers and user-trial consent; a Notability device.
rows.must_not_count_as_pass: Synthetic results; the 37/37 structural agreement; the 71/73 annotation ratio; fallback results; share-sheet evidence; desktop results used for iPad/Pencil; the generating model's self-score.
